title: 10.6 Segment Relationships in Circles

icans: I can find lengths of segments of chords that cross inside a circle.
I can find lengths of secant segments that meet outside a circle.
I can find lengths when a tangent and a secant meet outside a circle.

vocab: the two __________ of a chord that is cut by another chord
a segment that is tangent to a circle at one of its ____________
a segment that ___________ a chord and has exactly one endpoint outside the circle
the part of a secant segment that is __________ the circle

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Segments of Chords Theorem: if two chords cross inside a circle, the _______________ of the lengths of the segments of one chord equals the product for the other chord: EA · EB = EC · ED.

blocks.stem: Chords A̅B̅ and C̅D̅ cross at E. Find the value of x.

notes: Segments of Secants Theorem: if two secants share an endpoint outside a circle, then (external segment) · (_______________) is the same for both.
Segments of Secants and Tangents Theorem: if a tangent and a secant share an endpoint outside a circle, then the _______________ of the tangent segment = (external segment) · (whole secant segment).
titles: Segments of Secants and Tangents Theorem
